reason: B is the better, though imperfect, proposal because it makes temperature-resolved, channel-specific predictions and includes both low- and high-temperature falsification tests, whereas A largely repackages the exact MLFF Green–Kubo plus DFT–Boltzmann/deformation-potential workflow already described in E2. B still needs a more rigorous treatment of the Lorenz number and should distinguish static force-constant disorder from anharmonic scattering, but it offers a more substantive extension beyond the cited work.
